pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT — onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("The Boot button is the button on the right, located on GPIO7") and CircuitPython's pins.c (BUTTON/BOOT -> GPIO7). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin), matching this repo's adafruit_feather_scorpio / adafruit_feather_adalogger / adafruit_itsybitsy PIN_BUTTON precedent.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED (D13), active-high. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("controllable in CircuitPython code using board.LED, and in Arduino as PIN_LED") and CircuitPython's pins.c (LED -> GPIO13). digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability — fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias (and its dependent `static const uint8_t SS` line) from pins_arduino.h, confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide stating there is no dedicated CS pin on the main SPI header (GPIO13 was merely one of several arbitrary software-selectable SS choices: A3/D25/D13/D9), matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio / adafruit_feather_adalogger bus-alias-contamination fix pattern.

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes:
PIN_USB_HOST_DP — onboard native USB Type-A HOST connector D+ line (PIO-emulated USB host). Dedicated hardware, not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("USB Host Data Plus (D+) - GPIO 16") and CircuitPython's pins.c (USB_HOST_DATA_PLUS -> GPIO16). This board's own pins_arduino.h already omits a D16 alias (pre-existing pfodWeb NOTE), so this GPIO is currently invisible in the Designer pin picker; this explicit entry documents the exclusion and guards against a future accidental D-alias addition, matching the cytron_motion_2350_pro USB-host-pin informativeness precedent.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO17
pins.label: GPIO17
pins.notes:
PIN_USB_HOST_DM — onboard native USB Type-A HOST connector D- line. Same reasoning as GPIO16. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("USB Host Data Minus (D-) - GPIO 17") and CircuitPython's pins.c (USB_HOST_DATA_MINUS -> GPIO17).
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO18
pins.label: GPIO18
pins.notes:
PIN_5V_EN — onboard 5V boost-converter (TPS61023) enable line powering the USB host connector's peripheral bus. Dedicated hardware, not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("USB Host 5V Power - GPIO 18") and this board's own PIN_5V_EN=18u alias. This board's own pins_arduino.h already omits a D18 alias (pre-existing pfodWeb NOTE); this explicit entry documents the exclusion (same reasoning as GPIO16/17) — driving this pin as generic digital I/O would defeat the board's own USB-host power sequencing.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D20
pins.label: D20 (GPIO20)
pins.notes: NEOPIXEL_POWER — onboard NeoPixel power-gate line, must be driven HIGH to power the onboard NeoPixel (confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide: "there is a NeoPixel power pin on GPIO20. It needs to be set High for the NeoPixel to be powered"; and power-management guide: "enabled by default in CircuitPython and Arduino"). Unlike this repo's adafruit_qtpy/adafruit_itsybitsy NEOPIXEL_POWER precedent (where the equivalent pin has no D-alias at all and is therefore already invisible), this board's pins_arduino.h already carries a plain D20 alias, so digital_input and pwm_output are explicitly dropped here (no meaningful read-back value, and this is a binary power-enable line rather than a brightness/dimming line) while digital_output is kept (legitimate for a sketch to enable/disable NeoPixel power).

pins.name: D21
pins.label: GPIO21 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line. Power is separately gated by GPIO20 (NEOPIXEL_POWER, must be driven HIGH — see that entry). Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("It is connected to GPIO21") and CircuitPython's pins.c (NEOPIXEL -> GPIO21).
